question: NQRP is related to TWXV in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, EHIG is related to KNOM. To which of the following is LOPN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffb83bf1c80ea8005c2ed2fa26d989e5781ce468ec3b742100b1f413e7273250.png] 

The logic followed here is,

NQRP is related to TWXV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6347f302d4845e7fb188db1e40ada6cd9cfa645c4f548c01e95c65d857b56073.png] 

Also, EHIG is related to KNOM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bf240ba55cf78755d039aa7c3fdb8962ee3aeeb83d715734f956c0f4155c3aa.png] 

Similarly, LOPN is related to RUVT.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39767445fbb0d1f433c841d15cf52d0ad94c3e9fe0f61417e381b8a5bb5d5af2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
